name: Hydrogen
description: Hydrogen is the most abundant chemical substance in the universe, constituting roughly 75% of all baryonic mass.

name: Helium
description: Helium is the second lightest and second most abundant element in the observable universe.

name: Lithium
description: Lithium is a soft, silvery-white alkali metal. Under standard conditions, it is the lightest metal and the lightest solid element.

name: Beryllium
description: Beryllium is a relatively rare element in the universe, usually occurring as a product of the spallation of larger atomic nuclei that have collided with cosmic rays.

name: Boron
description: Boron is a low-abundance element in the Solar System and in the Earth's crust.

name: Carbon
description: Carbon is the 15th most abundant element in the Earth's crust, and the fourth most abundant element in the universe by mass after hydrogen, helium, and oxygen.

name: Nitrogen
description: Nitrogen is the most common element in Earth's atmosphere, making up about 78% by volume.

name: Oxygen
description: Oxygen is essential for respiration and is a major component of water.

name: Fluorine
description: Fluorine is the most electronegative element and is highly reactive.

name: Neon
description: Neon is a colorless, odorless, inert monatomic gas under standard conditions, with about two-thirds the density of air.

name: Sodium
description: Sodium is a soft, silvery-white, highly reactive metal.

name: Magnesium
description: Magnesium is the eighth most abundant element in the Earth's crust.

name: Aluminum
description: Aluminum is the most abundant metal in the Earth's crust.

name: Silicon
description: Silicon is the second most abundant element in the Earth's crust (about 28% by mass), after oxygen.

name: Phosphorus
description: Phosphorus exists in two major forms, white phosphorus and red phosphorus.

name: Sulfur
description: Sulfur is an essential element for all life, but almost always in the form of organosulfur compounds or metal sulfides.

name: Chlorine
description: Chlorine is the second most abundant halogen and 21st most abundant chemical element in Earth's crust.

name: Argon
description: Argon is the third-most abundant gas in the Earth's atmosphere, at 0.934% (9340 ppmv).

name: Potassium
description: Potassium is a silvery-white metal that is soft enough to be cut with a knife with little force.

name: Calcium
description: Calcium is the fifth most abundant element in Earth's crust, and the third most abundant metal, after iron and aluminum.
